<description>
Makes the suffix/TLD check case-insensitive when parsing `.onion` addresses, as is already done for I2P hostnames. With the current code, a name like `<addr>.ONION` will not be parsed as a Tor address, and will instead fall through to regular hostname resolution.
</description>
